entities.name: Civil Rights Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Mass movement for racial equality in the United States from the 1950s through 1960s. Led by figures like Martin Luther King Jr. and Rosa Parks, it achieved landmark legislation including the Civil Rights Act (1964) and Voting Rights Act (1965).
